title: Digi TX
author: gdeo607
description: TX KIT, a whole drum kit as one machine in the FUNC+SRC list: knob B (TYPE) picks the drum - BD9 and BD8 kicks, SD9 and SD8 snares, LT9 MT9 HT9 and LT8 MT8 HT8 toms, 909- and 808-style - and a p-lock on B plays another drum on that step. A TUNE sets the pitch (C4 and 0 play the original's) and the AMP envelope the decay; C SWT (sweep time), D VAR (variation), E TONE, F DRV (drive), G SNAP and H CHAR shape it. After the TX-8 and TX-9 machines of hugz202's AE-analog-rytm-mods (MIT), from their measurements; fully digital synthesis of our own. Needs Digi Mono 0.25 or later, which renders its voices, and machine-pages, which draws its SRC page.
